name: ISO 15552 Standard Heavy-Duty Pneumatic Cylinder (Ø63mm - 200mm)
tagline: High-cycle double-acting pneumatic cylinder with adjustable pneumatic cushioning for robotic automation.
description: Engineered for harsh industrial automation environments, our ISO 15552 profile cylinders feature hard anodized aluminum barrels, chrome-plated high-tensile steel piston rods, and self-lubricating Viton seals capable of up to 10 million endurance cycles.
bulletPoints: Conforms strictly to ISO 15552 & VDMA 24562 dimensional standards for universal replacement.
Hard anodized aluminum profile tube with integrated magnetic reed switch sensor slots on 3 sides.
Adjustable end-position pneumatic cushioning on both front and rear end caps.
Operating pressure range: 1.0 to 10.0 Bar | Operating temperature: -20°C to +80°C.
Supplied with standard factory MTC 3.1 material test certificate and 3D CAD STEP file.

name: 5/2 Way Pilot Operated Solenoid Valve (Namur / Subplate Mount)
tagline: Ultra-fast response 5-port 2-position directional air control valve with manual override.
description: High-flow directional solenoid valve designed for direct NAMUR interface mounting on rotary quarter-turn actuators or modular subplates. Features low-power 24VDC / 230VAC coils with IP65 DIN connectors.
bulletPoints: High flow rate of 1100 NL/min with low pressure drop design.
Die-cast aluminum body with anti-wear spool sleeve for 50 million cycles.
IP65 rated DIN 43650B coil with LED indicator light included.
Response time: < 20 ms for high-speed automated cycle control.
Equipped with lockable manual test override for commissioning.

name: Modular Air Filter Regulator Lubricator (FRL) Trio Unit (G 3/8")
tagline: 3-stage precision air treatment unit with 5-micron sintered bronze filter and automatic drain.
description: Protects downstream pneumatic machinery from particulate contamination, water condensation, and friction. Includes built-in precision pressure gauge and metallic bowl guard.
bulletPoints: 5-micron particulate filtration with 99.8% moisture separation efficiency.
Equipped with differential automatic float drain for zero-maintenance operation.
Locking pressure adjustment knob prevents unauthorized pressure tampering.
Proportional micro-fog oil mist lubrication with visual drip rate dome.
Modular bracket mounting for easy single-unit replacement.

name: 700 Bar High-Pressure Solenoid Directional Control Valve (CETOP 3 / NG6)
tagline: Zero-leakage poppet style directional valve engineered for 700 Bar hydraulic powerpacks.
description: High-pressure directional valve capable of operating up to 700 Bar (10,000 PSI). Featuring hardened tool-steel poppets and direct-acting solenoid actuation for stamping presses and torque wrench powerpacks.
bulletPoints: Maximum working pressure up to 700 Bar (10,000 PSI) with zero internal seat leakage.
Hardened alloy steel poppet seats ground to Ra 0.2 micron surface finish.
Standard CETOP 3 (D03 / NG6) subplate mounting footprint.
Heavy-duty wet-armature solenoid coils for continuous 100% ED duty cycle.
100% factory pressure-tested with hydraulic mineral oil at 1.5x proof pressure.

name: 350 Bar Custom Welded Hydraulic Cylinder (Bore Ø80mm - Stroke 400mm)
tagline: Heavy-duty welded clevis hydraulic cylinder with induction-hardened hard chrome rod.
description: Constructed from ST52 cold-drawn honed steel tubes with micro-honed Ra 0.2 ID finish and induction-hardened EN8D chrome-plated piston rod. Built for high-frequency mobile and stationary industrial hydraulic machinery.
bulletPoints: Operating working pressure: 350 Bar (5000 PSI) continuous.
Induction-hardened chrome rod with 50+ micron hard chrome plating (Corrosion tested 500h NSS).
Hallite / Parker multi-lip low-friction polyurethane hydraulic seal pack.
Spherical bearing clevis or trunnion mounting available upon request.
Supplied with hydro-test certificate showing zero drift under full tonnage.

name: 4-Station Parallel Circuit Hydraulic Manifold Block (CETOP 3 / NG6)
tagline: Precision CNC machined continuous hydraulic manifold block with integrated relief cavity.
description: Monoblock hydraulic manifold designed to mount up to 4 CETOP 3 directional valves in parallel. Features integrated P-line cavity for adjustable cartridge relief valves, black phosphated anti-corrosion coating.
bulletPoints: CNC precision milled from high-tensile 6061-T6 aluminum / ductile iron GGG40.
4 standard CETOP 03 / NG6 valve stations with standardized mounting holes.
Side A & B working ports G 3/8" BSPP | Pressure P & Tank T ports G 1/2" BSPP.
Integrated cavity for Sun / standard cavity relief valve.
Deep-hole gun-drilled internal cross passages ensuring minimal turbulent flow loss.
materials: Hard Anodized Aluminum 6061-T6 or Ductile Iron

name: All-Metal Nickel-Plated Brass Push-In Pneumatic Fitting (Ø10mm x G 1/4")
tagline: Full brass push-in fitting with stainless steel gripper collet for high-vibration automotive lines.
description: Manufactured from CW614N high-grade extrusion brass with chemical nickel plating. Suitable for harsh environments, spark-resistant welding cells, and high pressure pneumatic circuits up to 20 Bar.
bulletPoints: 100% full metallic brass body and release sleeve (Zero brittle plastic parts).
Stainless steel AISI 301 gripping collet provides secure bite on PU and PA tubing.
Pre-applied PTFE thread sealant on tapered male threads for instant leak-tight seal.
Operating temperature range: -20°C to +150°C (High heat resistant FKM O-ring).
Pressure rating: Vacuum to 20 Bar (290 PSI).

name: ISO 7241-B Standard Brass Quick Release Hydraulic Coupler (1/2" NPT)
tagline: Double shut-off poppet quick disconnect coupler machined from solid brass bar stock.
description: Conforms to ISO 7241 Series B standard. Built with stainless steel locking balls and dual shut-off poppet valves to prevent fluid loss during decoupling.
bulletPoints: Precision machined from solid free-cutting brass bar stock at our Jamnagar facility.
Double shut-off poppet valves eliminate oil spillage upon disconnection.
Stainless steel 316 locking balls ensure positive lock and long life.
Compatible with all major global ISO-B interchange couplers (Parker 60, Aeroquip FD45).
100% helium leak tested prior to packaging.

name: Custom 8-Port CNC Turned Rotary Air/Oil Distributor Manifold
tagline: Micron-precision multi-passage rotary union manifold with PTFE rotary seals for rotating indexing tables.
description: 5-axis CNC turned and milled rotary distribution manifold for high-speed indexing automation. Features micro-polished rotor shafts with diamond-burnished seal tracks.
bulletPoints: Machined on DMG MORI 5-axis CNC machining centers to ± 5 micron tolerances.
8 independent media passages for simultaneous pneumatic, hydraulic, and vacuum lines.
Dual precision deep groove ball bearings support high axial and radial loads.
Balanced mechanical rotary seals for continuous rotation up to 500 RPM.
Delivered with Zeiss CMM dimensional inspection report.
materials: Aircraft Grade Aluminum 7075-T6 & Stainless Steel Rotor

name: High-Precision 2-Finger Parallel Pneumatic Gripper (Stroke 20mm)
tagline: Cross-roller guided high rigidity pneumatic gripper with high repeatability (±0.01mm).
description: Engineered for high-speed pick and place automation, robotic end-of-arm tooling, and precision assembly lines. Features integrated magnetic sensor slots on both sides.
bulletPoints: Hardened steel cross-roller guide rails ensure high moment load capacity and smooth travel.
Repeatability accuracy: ± 0.01 mm for microscopic precision assembly.
Dust-proof sealing lip design prevents metal chip ingress.
Mounting holes on 3 body surfaces for flexible robotic arm integration.
Magnetic piston standard for auto-switch position sensing.

name: Pilot-Operated Hydraulic Check Valve (Poppet Type, G 3/4" BSP)
tagline: Heavy-duty load-holding pilot operated check valve preventing hydraulic cylinder drift.
description: Designed to securely hold hydraulic loads in position without drift during power shutoff or pump stop. Precision ground hardened poppet and steel seat ensure 100% leak-tight lock.
bulletPoints: Pilot ratio 1:4.5 ensures rapid decompression and smooth load release.
Hardened alloy steel poppet ground to optical flatness for zero seat leakage.
Direct in-line mounting or manifold sandwich mounting.
Max pressure rating: 350 Bar (5000 PSI) with cracking pressure of 0.5 Bar.
Ideal for overhead hydraulic hoists, press holding valves, and boom cylinders.

name: Hexagonal Brass Pneumatic Header Distribution Block (6-Way G 1/4")
tagline: Heavy-wall hexagonal brass air distribution header block with 1 main inlet and 6 outlet ports.
description: Precision extruded and CNC drilled brass header block for distributing compressed air to multiple machine tools, blow guns, or cylinder circuits from a single supply line.
bulletPoints: Extruded from solid CW617N brass for maximum burst pressure tolerance.
1 x G 1/2" Main Inlet Port + 6 x G 1/4" Outlet Branch Ports.
Pre-drilled mounting through-holes for easy machine chassis installation.
Corrosion-proof natural brass or electroless nickel finish.
Rated for operating pressures up to 30 Bar (435 PSI).
